summary: Full end-to-end validation of the Challenge 100-invites feature (backend CRUD, counting rules, single-active enforcement, no-auto-credit, admin UI, dashboard user card). 9/9 pytest cases pass against the preview URL. Frontend admin panel and user dashboard both render correctly with all expected data-testids. Fixed ONE real backend bug: PUT /api/admin/challenges/{id} was returning HTTP 500 (TypeError comparing tz-naive/tz-aware datetimes) instead of HTTP 400 when end_at was set before start_at.

minor.issue: FIXED. Motor returned tz-naive datetimes from Mongo, comparison against tz-aware new datetime raised TypeError → 500 instead of 400 when end<=start. Added defensive tz-normalization in challenges.py update_challenge().

action_items: None. All spec items validated. The tz-naive bug fix (challenges.py L169-176) is safe and idempotent; no further action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: challenges.py — _count_progress() uses `sponsor_id == user_id` which is the correct direct-referral definition per the MLM binary matrix spec. Progress rule verified via synthetic data (Cas 1 counts, Cas 2 counts, Cas 3 excluded, Cas 4 pending excluded).
challenges.py — Only-one-active is enforced BOTH at create (line 124) and at update-to-active (line 164). Verified end-to-end.

challenges.py — Original `if end <= start` (line 171 before fix) was comparing existing['start_at']/['end_at'] (tz-naive from Motor default codec_options) with data.end_at.astimezone(timezone.utc) (tz-aware). Same problem could occur in create_challenge if Pydantic ever returned a naive datetime, but ChallengeCreate calls astimezone() so it's safe there.

challenges.py — No commission/reward crediting logic exists anywhere in the module; the target-reached path only flips a client-side `completed` flag. Verified balance_profit is untouched when target is reached.
challenges.py — challenge_participants() correctly filters sponsor_id != None (line 202), so the seed 'outsider' scenario is excluded. Aggregation is efficient (single pipeline + per-sponsor lookup).

frontend/(admin)/index.tsx — All required data-testids present: chg-create, chg-name, chg-target, chg-reward, chg-currency, chg-start, chg-end, chg-active-toggle, chg-item-{id}, chg-participants-{id}, chg-toggle-{id}, chg-delete-{id}, admin-chg-participants-modal.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/admin/challenges/{id} bug: Motor's default codec returns Mongo BSON datetimes as tz-naive Python datetimes. The pre-existing challenge['start_at'] fetched from DB was tz-naive, while the request's data.end_at.astimezone(timezone.utc) is tz-aware. Python raises TypeError on `naive <= aware` comparisons, which propagated as HTTP 500. Fix: normalize both `start` and `end` to tz-aware (UTC) before comparison in update_challenge(). No data change required — existing DB documents remain valid.
